 Live .  18,789 viewing 18789 viewing Root and Brook steady England against Sri Lanka
 Thu 22 Oct 2026 , Men's One Day International Series Sri Lanka vs England (batting), in play Sri Lanka Sri Lanka In Play England England Yet to bat 167 -2 ( 28.0 ) England are 167 for 2 with 22.0 overs remaining Sri Lanka: yet to bat England innings: 167 for 2 from 28.0 overs, in play
 Live Reporting (active) 
 Scorecard 
 Summary
 Banton hits half-century as England put on 74 for first wicket
 Sri Lanka win toss and bowl first in Rawalpindi
 Tongue & Dawson replace Baker & Rashid for England
 Close form Have your say on England men this winter
 Get involved Live Reporting
 by Ffion Wynne
 Eng 167-2 published at 28 overs 28 overs 
 Sri Lanka skipper Kusal Mendis immediately whips Janith Liyanage out of the attack after his only over so far was whacked for 16, knowing the innings is already drifting away from them. 
 It doesn't really matter who's bowling, though. Harry Brook whacks Dasun Shanaka for four, beating despairing dives from two fielders as Sri Lanka's struggles in the field continue.
 0 0 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Rain clears and South Africa begin bid to beat Australia published at 11:04 BST 11:04 BST 
 Image source, Getty Images The skies have cleared in Gqeberha and South Africa's bid to beat Australia has just begun.
 Australia resumed still 170 runs behind South Africa's first-innings score with six wickets left.
 There should still be time for the Proteas to get their six wickets. Can they finish it off?

 If England stick with these two for the next three overs then they know they can flick a switch with 20 overs to go.
 Sri Lanka know they need a wicket soon.

 Eng 155-2 published at 27 overs 27 overs 
 Singles galore off Asitha Fernando's tidy over, but Brook and Root look untroubled. England have got a fine platform here to kick on way past 300. 
 25 1 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Post published at 10:59 BST 10:59 BST 
 Steven Finn 
Former England fast bowler on BBC Test Match Special 
 There's plenty of batters left for England but these two won't want to leave it up to anyone else. They will want a big defendable total here.
 And because Sri Lanka are only using four frontline bowlers, England have the chance to punish their fifth bowler and take on Janith Liyanage.

 The partnership between Brook and Root is now worth 64.

 Image source, Reuters Thanks, Mike.
 Well, Harry Brook is on the charge. He greets medium pacer Janith Liyanage with a thumping four down the ground before slog-sweeping for six with disdain. 
 86 2 Share close panel Share page Copy link About sharing 
 Eng 133-2 published at 25 overs 25 overs 
 Oooh, chopped past the stumps.
 Joe Root inside edges Dilshan Madushanka's delivery just past his wicket. He looks a little stalled at the minute - having reached 16 from 12 balls he's now on 25 from 30.
 Here's Ffion Wynne to take you through the rest of the innings.

 One more single for Harry Brook takes him to 26 from 27 balls.
 Joe Root faces a couple of dot balls to finish the over from Kamindu Mendis.

 Steven Finn 
Former England fast bowler on BBC Test Match Special 
 Overpitched from the bowler and punished for that. Harry Brook, even though he is struggling for his rhythm, isn't going to miss out on that on the half-volley.
 Brook makes no mistake.

 There's the boundaries!
 Harry Brook hits consecutive sixes off Kamindu Mendis, hitting a floaty delivery over long-off and then a slamming a drag-down over mid-wicket.

 Kamindu Mendis becomes Sri Lanka's sixth bowler of the day and the spinner concedes four runs from his first over.
 England have scored 19 runs off the last five overs, with no boundaries.
